title: Dimension-Six Twisted Convolution as Arithmetic Boundary Fusion of a Two-Base Lens-Space Beta Integral: Reproducibility Archive
description: Reproducibility archive for a research note reformulating the dimension-six case of the formal Twisted Convolution Conjecture as one boundary theorem for a two-base general modular quantum-dilogarithm packet. It contains the manuscript source and PDF, the exact two-base reformulation, endpoint-exclusion, and finite multiplier-ledger certificates, rigorous Arb enclosures, and regression tests. Dimension six remains conditional on the fusion-continuity conjecture stated in the note; it is not a closed proof, unlike the unconditional companion papers covering dimensions four, five, seven, and eight.
